nativeProblem: The public project blog can be unavailable, redirect unexpectedly, omit expected accessibility content, or contain workflow snippets rejected by the schema compiler.
operationalValue: For weekly target-page observation opportunities, independently assess the declared HTTP, domain, snapshot-length and keyword checks, and validate eligible workflow snippets with a pinned native compiler; count useful monitoring coverage without equating it with technical correctness.

nativeUnits.primary: Independently assessed page assertions (checks). A verified failure is useful monitoring work, not a passing page.
diagnostics: Fully passing explicit-check checkpoints (checkpoints), including latest compiler reference

page: HTTPS exact githubnext.com or www.githubnext.com hostname; credentials rejected
Accessibility snapshot length strictly greater than 5000 JavaScript UTF-16 code units; not HTML byte count
Detailed prompt keywords: case-sensitive GitHub, workflow and compile, plus agentic-workflows or agentic workflows
snippet: Root opening and closing --- frontmatter markers
At least one top-level on, engine, tools, permissions or safe-outputs field
Independent compile receipt bound to exact snippet bytes and immutable compiler revision
Zero snippets is known only from independently protected complete DOM extraction
A successful schema compile does not establish runtime behavior or factual correctness
